title: parietaria officinalis subsp. erecta
intro: Parietaria officinalis subsp. erecta, commonly known as the hairy cat's tail or upright Pellitory, is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing pain and swelling, as well as protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Parietaria officinalis subsp. erecta include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and relieve pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
